title: Implement balanced bracket checker in Python
description: Implement is_balanced(s) that returns True if all brackets in s are properly nested and closed. Supports (), [], {}.

files.tests/test_brackets.py:
from src.brackets import is_balanced

def test_empty():
    assert is_balanced('') is True

def test_simple_pairs():
    assert is_balanced('()') is True
    assert is_balanced('[]') is True
    assert is_balanced('{}') is True

def test_nested():
    assert is_balanced('({[]})') is True

def test_unbalanced():
    assert is_balanced('(]') is False
    assert is_balanced('([)]') is False
    assert is_balanced('(') is False
    assert is_balanced(')') is False

def test_mixed_chars():
    assert is_balanced('a(b[c]d)e') is True
    assert is_balanced('x(y]z') is False
